Terms of Use

Effective date: 2026-11-08. These terms cover the website tottertop.ipe.rest (the "Site") and, once it is released, the Tottertop mobile app (the "App"), operated by Davy Kim (ipe Studio) ("we").

1. The Site

The Site is provided as is, for information about the App. Tottertop is in development and has not been released: nothing on the Site is a promise of a feature, date or price.

2. The App (once released)

These terms for the App are a draft that will be finalized before release.

  • License. We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to install and use the App on your own devices for personal, non-commercial use. You may not copy, resell, reverse engineer or tamper with the App, except where the law allows it.
  • Rewarded ads. The App is planned to show ads served by third parties. Rewarded ads are optional: you choose whether to watch one, and any reward is granted only if you finish watching it. We do not control the content of third-party ads.
  • Remove-ads purchase. The App is planned to offer an optional one-time purchase that removes ads. It is billed and managed by the Apple App Store or Google Play, and refunds and restoring purchases follow the store's rules.
